diagnosis: Repeated actions are overrepresented in candidate/bad runs.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged action-target-state attempts and requiring a changed approach should prevent unproductive loops, improving task progress. The cost is extra state tracking and occasional premature switching when repetition is legitimately necessary.
policy_text: Before repeating an action on the same target, compare the relevant observable state with the prior attempt. If it is unchanged, do not repeat unchanged more than once; instead change the action, target, parameters, or strategy, or stop and report the blocker.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Candidate/bad runs contain 1,485 repeated operations out of 7,366 (20.16%); base/good runs contain 224 out of 3,780 (5.93%). Repetition is 3.40× as prevalent, with +1,261 candidate operations.
Repeated operations occur across 88 distinct candidate/bad source sessions versus 20 base/good sessions, showing recurrence rather than a single-run anomaly.
